title: Cosmic Heart Wagon
description: A winged fairy-like woman with long pink hair and a metallic red bodysuit kneels on a red Radio Flyer wagon, holding a melting framed painting. She is surrounded by floating hearts, eyeballs, and jellyfish-like creatures under a swirling purple galaxy sky with golden light beams.
prompt: A beautiful fairy woman with large yellow butterfly wings and flowing pink hair, wearing a form-fitting metallic red and silver bodysuit covered in hearts, kneels inside a red Radio Flyer wagon on a cobblestone path. She holds a gilded picture frame that is melting like Dali clocks, dripping white liquid. Floating red hearts, eyeballs, and translucent jellyfish drift through the air. A swirling purple and black galaxy vortex fills the sky with golden god rays breaking through. Ruined classical columns and butterflies in the background, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene.
